hypotheses.reasoning: notification-svc's messageCache grows without bounded eviction. From ~20:49 the heap stopped being reclaimed by GC (#1719: 78% after full GC, old gen not reclaimed), worsening to 87% with GC overhead 35% (#2171). It then hit OutOfMemoryError at messageCache.put (#2250), and the 2Gi pod was OOM-killed (#2253). Each restart re-warms the cache (#2284, #2516, #2693), and the heap is exhausted again within about 3-6 minutes (#2645, #2647, #2479, #2482). Each kill drops in-flight notify connections, so api-gateway returns 502 'upstream notification-svc connection reset (no healthy upstream)' (#2362, #2411, #2556, #3098). Those 502s are the downstream symptom, not the cause. Ruled out: the template-svc render slowness (#1118) was a soft-threshold warning, not an outage; the 400 validation (#399) and 429 throttle (#1064) are client-side; the translation 401s (#2300, #2383) and catalog/search 502s affect the search path, not /v1/notify; the legacy-inventory healthcheck timeouts (#2215) come from a deprecated, unrelated poller. No deploy event is logged; the version is v1.21.3 throughout, so this points to an unbounded cache rather than a release.

The cache-warming startups all report v1.21.3, and the cache growth may have been introduced by that release. No explicit deploy event appears in the logs, and heap growth began about 13 minutes into the window with no release marker, so this is a weaker alternative to the unbounded-cache resource exhaustion.

verdict.recommendedAction: Immediately restart or scale notification-svc to stop the OOM loop. Bound messageCache with TTL/LRU eviction and set a heap limit that fits the 2Gi container limit. Add a heap/cache-size alert. Check whether the cache growth started with the v1.21.3 rollout or a traffic shift, and consider rolling back to a version with bounded caching if one exists. Separately, fix the translation API key (401s in catalog-svc) and the deprecated legacy-inventory healthcheck, which are unrelated noise.

hypotheses.reasoning: notification-svc's messageCache grows without bounded eviction. From ~20:49 the heap stopped being reclaimed by GC (#1719: 78% after full GC, old gen not reclaimed), worsening to 87% with GC overhead 35% (#2171). It then hit OutOfMemoryError at messageCache.put (#2250), and the 2Gi pod was OOM-killed (#2253). Each restart re-warms the cache (#2284, #2516, #2693), and the heap is exhausted again within about 3-6 minutes (#2645, #2647, #2479, #2482). Each kill drops in-flight notify connections, so api-gateway returns 502 'upstream notification-svc connection reset (no healthy upstream)' (#2362, #2411, #2556, #3098). Those 502s are the downstream symptom, not the cause. Ruled out: the template-svc render slowness (#1118) was a soft-threshold warning, not an outage; the 400 validation (#399) and 429 throttle (#1064) are client-side; the translation 401s (#2300, #2383) and catalog/search 502s affect the search path, not /v1/notify; the legacy-inventory healthcheck timeouts (#2215) are a deprecated, unrelated poller. No deploy event is logged; the version is v1.21.3 throughout, so this points to an unbounded cache rather than a release.
hypotheses.recommendedAction: Immediately restart or scale notification-svc and stop the OOM loop. Check whether the cache started growing with a recent change (v1.21.3 rollout or traffic shift), and consider rolling back to a version with bounded caching if one exists. Separately, fix the translation API key (401s in catalog-svc) and the deprecated legacy-inventory healthcheck, which are unrelated noise.
